headline: Central Bank of Turkey Returns to Net Liquidity Deficit Position
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey's net funding position shifted to a positive 184 billion liras on November 20, marking the first market liquidity deficit in five months.
why: TCMB liquidity conditions reflect commercial bank funding demand and official monetary policy tightness.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Turkey's central bank net liquidity moved into a deficit for the first time in five months.
